scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.install:all: npm install --include=dev && npm install --prefix server --include=dev && npm install --prefix client --include=dev
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix client && npm run build --prefix server
scripts.render-build: npm install --include=dev && npm install --prefix server --include=dev && npm install --prefix client --include=dev && npm run build
scripts.host: npm run build && npm start --prefix server
